scope: Read-only enabled project current-account verified database snapshot; no collection or writes

mapping.source: JdbcDashboardSnapshotReader current day pointer -> verified DayEvidence.sourceType/date
mapping.rule: max(date) among sourceType=MCP_AUTO in the project's account verified current snapshot; complete empty days qualify
mapping.null: Successful verified snapshot contains no current MCP_AUTO day
mapping.validation: Existing account/date/current-version/row-count/fact-hash verification applies; raw source files are not re-read by this endpoint

errors.503: FACT_QUERY_UNAVAILABLE: snapshot read or verification failed; must not display as successful no-MCP null

compatibility: Separate contract; dashboard-query-1.7.0 and all calculation semantics unchanged
evidence: JdbcDashboardSnapshotReaderTest current pointer and source/hash validation
